name: Lawrence 1917 flamethrower fuel tank
body:
Source Pathfinder #71: Rasputin Must Die! pg. 64
Statistics
Cost 50 gp Weight 9 lbs.
Category Ammunition; Proficiency Exotic
Description
This pair of tanks—one filled with oil, and the other a propellant— provides enough flammable material to use a flamethrower six times.
